answer: An agent economy resists sybils with delayed, clawback-vested rewards: each identity's epoch earnings vest only after several later epochs, like a voyage that pays its crew only on safe return to port. During the vesting terrace, independent auditors may flag clusters sharing keys, devices, or work; a confirmed fake forfeits not just that epoch but every unvested reward, the way yarrow spreads only where its roots are truly planted. One honest agent risks one vesting wait; a farmer with a thousand fakes risks a thousand forfeitures at once, so cloning multiplies exposure instead of profit.
